facts.text: Solitaire Lodge sits on a private peninsula over Lake Tarawera, with a natural bush setting and a volcanic backdrop.
facts.excerpt: Solitaire Lodge enjoys breathtaking views from a private peninsula over Lake Tarawera, lush natural bush setting and dramatic volcanic backdrop.

facts.text: The suites have floor-to-ceiling windows and private balconies looking over Lake Tarawera.
facts.excerpt: Luxurious suites feature floor to ceiling windows and private balconies with a stunning vista over Lake Tarawera.

facts.text: The lodge has views over Lake Tarawera towards the volcanic craters of Mount Tarawera.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy panoramic views over Lake Tarawera’s still deep waters and towards the magnificent volcanic crators of Mount Tarawera.

facts.text: The full board tariff includes a complimentary mini bar, pre-dinner drinks and canapes, a five-course evening meal, full country breakfast and light lunch.
facts.excerpt: Solitaire Lodge’s Full Board Tariff includes daily: complimentary mini bar (alcoholic & non-alcoholic beverages & snacks). Pre-dinner drinks & canapés, five course evening meal (wine matches extra), full country breakfast and light lunch.

facts.text: The chefs create daily changing menus with a seasonal New Zealand focus.
facts.excerpt: Our chefs enjoy the challenges of creating daily changing seasonal menus which reflect a New Zealand taste experience.

facts.text: Dinner can be taken with fellow guests in the lodge's dining room or as an intimate dinner for two in the suite.
facts.excerpt: Engage in lively conversation with fellow guests in the lodge’s dining room, or choose an intimate dinner for two in your suite.

facts.text: Use of the lodge's dinghies, kayaks and safety equipment is included in the stay.
facts.excerpt: Use of lodge dinghies, kayaks and safety equipment is included in your stay.

facts.text: Guests can paddle the protected waters of the Otumutu Lagoon, home to ancient Maori sites.
facts.excerpt: Paddle the protected waters of the Otumutu Lagoon, home to ancient Maori sites.

facts.text: Guests can swim or picnic at a private secluded beach on the lodge's peninsula.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy a swim or a picnic lunch at a private secluded beach on the lodge’s private peninsula.

facts.text: A 15-minute private launch excursion reaches the natural hot springs of Lake Tarawera.
facts.excerpt: Take a 15 minute private launch excursion to the natural hot springs of Lake Tarawera.

facts.text: Guests can take a helicopter trip to the summit of Mount Tarawera.
facts.excerpt: Experience a breathtaking trip by helicopter to the summit of Mount Tarawera.

facts.text: The Tarawera Falls Walk is a half-day experience that starts with a short speedboat transfer to the Tarawera outlet stream.
facts.excerpt: This invigorating half day experience starts with a short speedboat transfer to the trout laden Tarawera outlet stream, – the starting point for the scenic walk to the Tarawera Falls.

facts.text: Guests can take a private 4WD and hike to the 1111m summit of Mount Tarawera.
facts.excerpt: Private 4WD and hike to the magnificent 1111m Summit of Mount Tarawera.

facts.text: The Solitaire Suite is set in a separate building, with one or two bedrooms and picture windows looking across Lake Tarawera towards Mount Tarawera.
facts.excerpt: Set in a separate building, this 1 or 2 bedroom suite offers peace, total privacy and an expansive outlook through picture windows across glassy Lake Tarawera and towards Mount Tarawera.

facts.text: The stand-alone Villa Suite comes in one- or two-bedroom configurations and is described as ideal for families, groups or couples wanting space.
facts.excerpt: Offered in a 1 or 2 bedroom configuration, the stand alone Villa Suite is ideal for families, groups or a spacious couple’s retreat.

facts.text: The Villa Suite's master ensuite has a freestanding bath overlooking the lake.
facts.excerpt: The ground floor features a master bedroom with lavish super king bed, ensuite with a freestanding bath overlooking the lake, kitchenette, dining/living area and private outdoor deck.

facts.text: Solitaire Lodge is a member of Luxury Lodges of New Zealand.
facts.excerpt: Solitaire Lodge is a member of Luxury Lodges of New Zealand and was recently awarded a Michelin Key for 2026.

facts.text: Solitaire Lodge was awarded a Michelin Key for 2026.
facts.excerpt: Solitaire Lodge is a member of Luxury Lodges of New Zealand and was recently awarded a Michelin Key for 2026.

facts.text: The lodge has a private helipad and a private jetty.
facts.excerpt:
Private helipad
Private jetty

facts.text: Guests should contact the lodge hosts for cost and availability of the suggested experiences and excursions.
facts.excerpt: Please contact the Lodge hosts for details on cost and availability for all our suggested experiences and excursions.

facts.text: Additional alcoholic beverages are added to the guest bill.
facts.excerpt: Additional alcholic beverages will be added to guest bill.

facts.text: Shoreline trails on the lodge grounds lead through native bush.
facts.excerpt: Explore shoreline trails on lodge grounds through native bush.
